{{Article header|deck=A utility module that instantly dumps a ship's heat into an ejected heatsink, used for emergency cooling or stealth.

{{Article status|status=Needs review|mode=Both|version=Elite Dangerous, current Live and Legacy|reviewed=2026-08-20|reviewer=EDFM Engineer link-graph pass|source_quality=Well-established community consensus (INARA outfitting/engineering database), cross-checked against this wiki's already-cited Engineer articles}}

The '''Heat Sink Launcher''' rapidly transfers a ship's internally stored heat into a physical heatsink, which is then ejected from the ship.

== Overview ==

A Heat Sink Launcher has two common uses: emergency cooling when a ship is running dangerously hot (for example after sustained Power Plant use or laser fire), and stealth, since a ship running with very low heat is far harder for hostile sensors and missiles to detect and track. Each activation consumes one heatsink from a limited magazine, so it's a resource to spend deliberately rather than a passive cooling system.
